settings.support.blurb.original: If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting its development:
settings.support.blurb.translation: If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting its development:

settings.support.mission.original: …and help seed a bigger vision: technology that serves people and planet..
settings.support.mission.translation: …and help seed a bigger vision: technology that serves people and planet..

settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.original: Path to the templater plugin template file to use
settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.translation: Path to the templater plugin template file to use

settings.transcripts.info.original: Transcript settings control how and where your extracted notes are saved, which youtube data API key to use (required for channel/playlist processing), and optional language-translation parameters.
settings.transcripts.info.translation: Transcript settings control how and where your extracted notes are saved, which youtube data API key to use (required for channel/playlist processing), and optional language-translation parameters.

settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.original: The root folder where transcript subfolders will be organized (e.g., inbox, notes, etc.)
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.translation: The root folder where transcript subfolders will be organised (e.g., inbox, notes, etc.)

settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.original: Your Google cloud console API key for accessing public YouTube transcripts (not an OAUTH token). Required for downloading channels and playlists.
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.translation: Your Google cloud console API key for accessing public YouTube transcripts (not an OAUTH token). Required for downloading channels and playlists.

settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.original: Optional key for scrapecreators transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method. Get a free key at app.scrapecreators.com (100 requests free). Recommended for reliable transcript retrieval; direct YouTube extraction breaks when YouTube changes how captions are served.
settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.translation: Optional key for scrapecreators transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method. Get a free key at app.scrapecreators.com (100 requests free). Recommended for reliable transcript retrieval; direct YouTube extraction breaks when YouTube changes how captions are served.

settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.original: Optional key for supadata transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method (if no scrapecreators key). Get a key at supadata.ai.
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.translation: Optional key for supadata transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method (if no scrapecreators key). Get a key at supadata.ai.

settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.original: Target language code for translation (e.g., en, es, fr, de). Use "en" to keep content in english.
settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.translation: Target language code for translation (e.g., en, es, fr, de). Use "en" to keep content in english.

settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.original: Target country/region code for translation (e.g., us, gb, ca). Used for region-specific language variants.
settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.translation: Target country/region code for translation (e.g., us, gb, ca). Used for region-specific language variants.

settings.llm.info.original: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key, and pick a model. Temperature controls creativity; max tokens caps output length. Suggested for most users: Google provider with the gemini-2.5-flash model — fast, inexpensive, and high-quality. If you hit rate limits or reliability issues, OpenRouter is a solid fallback.
settings.llm.info.translation: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key, and pick a model. Temperature controls creativity; max tokens caps output length. Suggested for most users: Google provider with the gemini-2.5-flash model — fast, inexpensive, and high-quality. If you hit rate limits or reliability issues, OpenRouter is a solid fallback.

settings.llm.provider.desc.original: Provider used for summarization. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; lower-cost Gemini tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.provider.desc.translation: Provider used for summarisation. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; lower-cost Gemini tiers can be throttled.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.original: Stored in Obsidian secret storage, not in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.translation: Stored in Obsidian secret storage, not in plugin data.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.original: Server URL, stored in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.translation: Server URL, stored in plugin data.

settings.llm.model.desc.original: Select a preset model or type a custom model name below.
settings.llm.model.desc.translation: Select a preset model or type a custom model name below.

settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.original: Required: this model isn't in the registry — set context window, max output, and reserve % so token budgeting can size requests safely.
settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.translation: Required: this model isn't in the registry — set context window, max output, and reserve % so token budgeting can size requests safely.

settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.original: These are this model's token limits, prefilled from known data. Edit a field to override it for this provider and model.
settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.translation: These are this model's token limits, prefilled from known data. Edit a field to override it for this provider and model.

settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.original: Total context window in thousands of tokens (e.g., 400 for 400k tokens)
settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.translation: Total context window in thousands of tokens (e.g., 400 for 400k tokens)

settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.original: Maximum output tokens in thousands (e.g., 128 for 128k tokens)
settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.translation: Maximum output tokens in thousands (e.g., 128 for 128k tokens)

settings.llm.inputMax.desc.original: Explicit input cap if vendor publishes one (leave empty to auto calculate)
settings.llm.inputMax.desc.translation: Explicit input cap if vendor publishes one (leave empty to auto calculate)

settings.llm.reservePct.desc.original: Safety reserve for output tokens (0.10 = 10%, default: {default})
settings.llm.reservePct.desc.translation: Safety reserve for output tokens (0.10 = 10%, default: {default})

settings.llm.temperature.desc.original: Controls randomness of output (0-1). Lower is more focused, higher is more creative. Current value: {value}
settings.llm.temperature.desc.translation: Controls randomness of output (0-1). Lower is more focused, higher is more creative. Current value: {value}

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.original: Automatically add date to the beginning of note filenames
settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.translation: Automatically add date to the beginning of note filenames

settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.original: Format for date prepended to note titles
settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.translation: Format for date prepended to note titles

settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating fast summaries
settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.translation: Instructions for the llms behaviour when generating fast summaries

settings.prompts.userFast.desc.original: Specific instructions for summarizing the transcript quickly and concisely
settings.prompts.userFast.desc.translation: Specific instructions for summarising the transcript quickly and concisely

settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.original: Please summarize the following YouTube transcript...
settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.translation: Please summarise the following YouTube transcript...

settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating detailed, comprehensive summaries
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.translation: Instructions for the llms behaviour when generating detailed, comprehensive summaries

settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.original: Specific instructions for creating detailed and structured notes from the transcript
settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.translation: Specific instructions for creating detailed and structured notes from the transcript

settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.original: From the transcript below, create detailed and structured notes...
settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.translation: From the transcript below, create detailed and structured notes...

settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.original: Choose the default summary mode to use when the plugin starts. Fast summary mode skips timestamp links for quicker processing.
settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.translation: Choose the default summary mode to use when the plugin starts. Fast summary mode skips timestamp links for quicker processing.

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.original: Add links to each numbered section heading that jump to the corresponding timestamp in the YouTube video (note: disabled in fast summary mode)
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.translation: Add links to each numbered section heading that jump to the corresponding timestamp in the YouTube video (note: disabled in fast summary mode)

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.original: When enabled, reduces first pass tokens by 12% to make room for links. Automatically disabled in fast summary mode.
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.translation: When enabled, reduces first pass tokens by 12% to make room for links. Automatically disabled in fast summary mode.

settings.advanced.info.original: Advanced settings for debugging and troubleshooting. Enable debug logging to get detailed information appended to each note for technical support.
settings.advanced.info.translation: Advanced settings for debugging and troubleshooting. Enable debug logging to get detailed information appended to each note for technical support.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.original: Enable detailed debug logs. When enabled, debug information will be appended to each note as a hidden callout for troubleshooting.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.translation: Enable detailed debug logs. When enabled, debug information will be appended to each note as a hidden callout for troubleshooting.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.original: When enabled, debug information will be collected and added to notes as a hidden callout instead of being logged to the console.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.translation: When enabled, debug information will be collected and added to notes as a hidden callout instead of being logged to the console.

license.modal.loadError.original: Could not load license file. Please check that a license file exists in your plugin directory.
license.modal.loadError.translation: Could not load licence file. Please check that a licence file exists in your plugin directory.

license.required.message.original: You must accept the plugin license before using this feature.
license.required.message.translation: You must accept the plugin licence before using this feature.

license.required.instruction.original: Please go to the plugin settings and accept the license terms to continue.
license.required.instruction.translation: Please go to the plugin settings and accept the licence terms to continue.

license.required.step2.original: Scroll down to the "Community Plugins" section in the sidebar
license.required.step2.translation: Scroll down to the "Community Plugins" section in the sidebar

license.required.step3.original: Find "Tubesage" in the Community Plugins list
license.required.step3.translation: Find "Tubesage" in the Community Plugins list

license.required.step5.original: Toggle "Accept License" to enable the plugin
license.required.step5.translation: Toggle "Accept Licence" to enable the plugin
